title: Scary mall world
content: when I was an older kid, my most common nightmares (other than UFO nightmares…that’s another story lmao) were about a hell-like mall world. In this mall world, I think the most common features were -Escalators that were sharp almost everywhere and escalated into cliffs -Disgusting, maze-like bathrooms -Various bodily fluids here and there in most of the mall, mostly blood I still have these mall world nightmares occasionally, but it almost seems like things are better now? Anyone else have these?
